reviews.title: How can i unsubscribe after i had a free 3 day trial?
You don’t need pay for it
Subscription
reviews.text: The app is good and all, but there are no settings option to stop the subscription. The first thing the app ask is for subscription, without it you can’t even enter the app, I got 3 days of trial period, I was trying to end my subscription and I try to find it in the settings, but there are no options at all. How strange?
